_說明: 敵方（紅）用絕對欄 10～15（10 是前排）；我方固定兵（藍）用 0～5（5 是前排）。type：0劍 1盾 2弓 3騎 4刺。budget＝玩家可再花的金；allowed＝可用兵種。star2＝勝方剩餘戰力門檻%、star3＝花費上限。全部用 tools/validate_puzzles.gd 驗證過至少兩類解法、什麼都不放會輸。

tutorial.hint_zh: 弓箭手怕騎兵：騎兵有皮甲（箭傷減半），衝鋒還會加倍。把騎兵放在前排就好！
tutorial.hint_en: Archers fear cavalry: hide armor halves arrows, and the charge hits double. Just put cavalry up front!

tutorial.hint_zh: 盾兵正面擋箭、刺客開場會潛行繞到背後背刺（×2）。用盾兵吸火，刺客去切盾兵的背。
tutorial.hint_en: Shields block arrows from the front; assassins start stealthed and backstab (×2). Let shields soak, assassins hit backs.

tutorial.hint_zh: 對方剛擺下三隻騎兵要衝你的弓箭手。盾兵會頂住衝鋒、還有拒馬（打騎兵×2）——補在弓手前面！
tutorial.hint_en: They just placed three cavalry aimed at your archers. Shields brace charges and hit cavalry ×2 — put them in front!

puzzles.hint_en: One shield can't cover two lanes.
What do swordsmen get pulled toward?

puzzles.hint_zh: 三路騎兵，你只有二十五金。
puzzles.hint_en: Three lanes of cavalry, twenty-five gold.
Every iron wall has a soft back.

puzzles.hint_zh: 四個刺客要來切你的弓手。
puzzles.hint_en: Four assassins are coming for your archers.

puzzles.hint_zh: 盾在前、劍在中、弓在後——標準梯隊。
puzzles.hint_en: Shields, blades, bows — a textbook column.

puzzles.hint_zh: 你的兩面盾被包圍了，救還是不救？
puzzles.hint_en: Your two shields are surrounded. Save them?

puzzles.hint_zh: 上路慢推、下路快攻，先處理誰？
puzzles.hint_en: A slow push up top, a fast raid below. Which first?

puzzles.hint_zh: 便宜的兵也能拖住主力。
puzzles.hint_en: A cheap unit can hold up a big one.

puzzles.hint_zh: 完整的混合陣，你只剩三十金。
puzzles.hint_en: A full combined army. You have thirty gold.

new_units.hint_zh: 四匹小馬衝過來了。長槍兵讓衝鋒白費，還能從遠一點的地方刺。
new_units.hint_en: Four ponies are charging. Pikes waste their charge and poke from a step away.

new_units.hint_zh: 六面大盾擠在一起，弓箭射不穿。火罐從上面掉下來，專拆盾牆。
new_units.hint_en: Six shields packed tight — arrows bounce off. Fire pots fall from above and wreck shields.

new_units.hint_zh: 七個劍士衝過來，盾牆撐不久。在牆後放醫者輪流補血，撐到對面先倒。
new_units.hint_en: Seven swords are charging and the wall won't hold alone. Put medics behind it and outlast them.

new_units.hint_zh: 只能放一個鼓手。放在哪裡，大家才都聽得到鼓聲？
new_units.hint_en: You get one drummer. Where should it stand so everyone hears the beat?

new_units.hint_zh: 一排盾牌擋在前面，你的弓箭手射不穿。讓狂戰士劈開一段牆，弓箭就射得進去了。
new_units.hint_en: A line of shields your archers can't shoot through. Let a berserker split the wall open.

fantasy_units.hint_zh: 敵人都會走中間。把孢子菇放在路上，再讓弓箭手慢慢射。
fantasy_units.hint_en: The enemy marches straight through the middle. Put Sporecaps on the road and let archers do the rest.

fantasy_units.hint_zh: 盾牆擠得很緊。別把羊貼著自己人，也別讓弓手先把牠射倒。
fantasy_units.hint_en: The shield wall is packed tight. Keep the sheep away from your own troops, and don't let archers drop it first.

fantasy_units.hint_zh: 敵人一定會衝過來。放幾個寶箱在路上等他們。
fantasy_units.hint_en: They'll charge for sure. Leave a few chests on the road and wait.

fantasy_units.zh: 史萊姆・打不死的前排
fantasy_units.en: Slime: The Front Line That Won't Quit
fantasy_units.hint_zh: 刺客和劍士都是一對一的高手。史萊姆讓他們一直有東西要砍。
fantasy_units.hint_en: Assassins and swordsmen love a one-on-one. Slimes keep giving them more to cut.

fantasy_units.en: Ghost: Straight to the Back Line
fantasy_units.hint_zh: 盾牆後面全是弓箭手。箭對幽靈沒用，盾牆也擋不住。
fantasy_units.hint_en: Nothing but archers behind that shield wall. Arrows pass right through ghosts, and shields can't stop them.

fantasy_units.hint_zh: 狂戰士打得又快又痛。把娃娃放在它正對面，讓它也嚐嚐。
fantasy_units.hint_en: Berserkers hit fast and hard. Put a doll right across from one and let it taste its own medicine.

fantasy_units.hint_zh: 前排快撐不住時，沙漏會定住敵人。把它放在主力中間。
fantasy_units.hint_en: When the front line is failing, the hourglass freezes the enemy. Put it in the middle of your main force.

fantasy_units.en: Bone Mage: Back on Your Feet
fantasy_units.hint_zh: 前排倒下不是結束。法師站在後面，把大家叫起來。
fantasy_units.hint_en: A fallen front line isn't the end. Keep the mage in the back and call everyone back up.

fantasy_units.hint_zh: 敵人站得很散。貓把他們吸成一團，羊就有事做了。
fantasy_units.hint_en: The enemy is spread out. The cat clumps them together, and then the sheep have work to do.

fantasy_units.hint_zh: 騎兵撞上石魔只會被拍開。死了還會留下碎石，讓後面的衝不起來。
fantasy_units.hint_en: Cavalry that hit a golem just get swatted away. Even when it falls, the rubble breaks the next charge.

chapters.story_zh: 公會剛開張，只招得到王國的老兵。先學會盾、弓、騎、劍、刺客怎麼互相剋。
chapters.story_en: The guild has just opened and only kingdom veterans have signed up. Learn how shields, bows, horses, swords and assassins beat each other.

chapters.story_zh: 長槍兵、投彈兵、醫者、鼓手、狂戰士來報到了。每一位都有一招別人學不來的。
chapters.story_en: Pikes, bombers, medics, drummers and berserkers report for duty. Each has one trick nobody else can do.

chapters.story_zh: 連魔物都來應徵了。牠們不懂規矩，但很好用。
chapters.story_en: Even monsters want the job. They don't follow the rules, but they get results.

chapters.story_zh: 王國兵和魔物一起上場。有些組合放在一起，會發生意想不到的事。
chapters.story_en: Soldiers and monsters side by side. Some pairs do things neither could alone.

chapters.story_zh: 三四種兵一起配合，敵人也開始混搭了。
chapters.story_en: Three or four kinds working together, and now the enemy mixes too.

chapters.story_zh: 委託不再只是打贏：有人要保護、有時間要撐、有頭目要拿下。
chapters.story_en: Contracts get specific: someone to protect, a clock to beat, a leader to take down.

chapters.story_zh: 河、樹林、冰湖、熔岩、峽谷。地形會擋路、會拖慢、也會加速。
chapters.story_en: Rivers, woods, ice, lava and canyons. Terrain blocks, slows and speeds.

chapters.story_zh: 兵不能多帶，或乾脆借敵人的力。
chapters.story_en: Bring fewer units, or turn the enemy's tricks against them.

chapters.story_zh: 公會發下技能卷軸。戰前寫好第幾秒放，開打後就改不了。
chapters.story_en: The guild hands out skill scrolls. Write down when to cast before battle; once it starts, no changes.

chapters.story_zh: 最後的委託，什麼都可能出現。落子無悔。
chapters.story_en: The final contracts. Anything goes. No take-backs.

extra.hint_zh: 盾牆後面的醫者一直在補血。刺客會潛行過去。
extra.hint_en: Medics behind the wall keep healing. Assassins slip past.

extra.hint_zh: 敵人擠成一團。投彈兵從後面丟火罐，盾兵擋住前面。
extra.hint_en: They are packed tight. Bombers lob from the back; shields hold the front.

extra.hint_zh: 盾兵站前面，弓箭手躲在後面慢慢射。
extra.hint_en: Shields in front, archers behind them.

extra.hint_zh: 盾兵擋箭，醫者在後面補血，撐到對方的劍士先倒。
extra.hint_en: Shields soak the arrows; a medic behind keeps them standing.

extra.hint_zh: 鼓手站在人群中間，身邊的劍士都會打得更快。
extra.hint_en: Put the drummer in the middle of your swordsmen.

extra.hint_zh: 敵方的爆爆羊在半路被打死，會連自己人一起炸。
extra.hint_en: Enemy sheep killed on the way explode on their own side.

extra.hint_zh: 前排會倒，但倒下的還能被骷髏法師叫起來再擋一波。
extra.hint_en: Your front will fall, and a skeleton mage can raise them again.

extra.hint_zh: 巫毒娃娃綁住對面的狂戰士，它打得越痛自己越痛。
extra.hint_en: The voodoo doll binds a berserker: the harder it hits, the more it hurts itself.

extra.hint_zh: 投彈兵近身就丟不了火罐。幽靈會穿過盾牆貼上去。
extra.hint_en: Bombers can't lob at point blank. Ghosts drift through the wall.

extra.hint_zh: 敵人一定會走過中間。把孢子菇種在路上，讓弓箭手慢慢射。
extra.hint_en: They must cross the middle. Plant sporecaps on the road.

extra.hint_zh: 刺客一刀一隻。史萊姆打倒了會分裂，刺客砍不完。
extra.hint_en: Assassins kill one at a time. Slimes split when they fall.

extra.hint_zh: 盾牆擋得住箭，可是被狂戰士打過的盾兵就擋不住了。
extra.hint_en: A shield wall stops arrows, unless a berserker has breached it.

extra.hint_zh: 寶箱怪等人上門咬一大口。放在敵人一定會經過的空地。
extra.hint_en: The mimic bites whoever walks by. Put it where they must pass.

extra.hint_zh: 敵人散得很開，羊一次炸不到幾隻。先讓貓把他們吸成一團。
extra.hint_en: They are spread out. Let the cat pull them together first.

extra.hint_zh: 長槍兵讓騎兵的衝鋒白費。先讓狂戰士打亂他們，騎兵再衝。
extra.hint_en: Pikes stop the charge. Let a berserker breach them first.

extra.hint_zh: 鼓手讓身邊的人打得更快。衝鋒的時候也要有人敲鼓。
extra.hint_en: Drums speed up everyone nearby, even a charge.

extra.hint_zh: 狂戰士一起衝上來時，前排快倒的瞬間，沙漏精靈會讓時間停下來。
extra.hint_en: When your front is about to break, the hourglass sprite stops time.

extra.hint_zh: 前排一直倒，又一直站起來、一直分裂。拖久了就是你的。
extra.hint_en: Your front keeps falling, splitting and getting back up. Drag it out.

extra.hint_zh: 前面是盾，後面是長槍，再後面還有醫者。一層一層拆。
extra.hint_en: Shields, then pikes, then medics. Peel them one layer at a time.

extra.hint_zh: 敵方的貓會把你的兵吸過去，包括你的爆爆羊。
extra.hint_en: Their cats pull your units in, sheep included.

extra.hint_zh: 盾兵會把近戰的敵人吸過來打它。讓它站在毒圈裡。
extra.hint_en: Shields draw melee foes to them. Stand them inside the spores.

extra.hint_zh: 騎兵衝得又快又痛。碎石會讓他們變慢，長槍兵專門擋騎兵。
extra.hint_en: Rubble slows the riders; pikes stop them.

extra.hint_zh: 火罐要打擠成一團的敵人。貓會幫你把他們擠在一起。
extra.hint_en: Pots love a crowd. The cat makes one.

extra.hint_zh: 弓箭手躲在盾牆後面。幽靈不必走正門。
extra.hint_en: Archers hide behind the wall. Ghosts don't use the front door.

extra.hint_zh: 什麼都有的敵陣，你也什麼都能帶。找出最划算的組合。
extra.hint_en: They brought everything, and so can you. Find the best mix.

extra.hint_zh: 滿滿的爆爆羊衝過來。別讓牠們一次炸光你。
extra.hint_en: A flock of boom sheep. Don't let them blow up everything at once.

extra.hint_zh: 骷髏法師一直把倒下的叫起來。先打倒它。
extra.hint_en: The skeleton mage keeps raising the fallen. Take it down.

extra.hint_zh: 騎兵會從兩側繞過來找鼓手。
extra.hint_en: The riders will swing round the flanks for your drummer.

extra.hint_zh: 打不贏沒關係，撐到時間到就好。
extra.hint_en: You don't need to win. Just still be standing when time runs out.

extra.hint_zh: 刺客只想找醫者。醫者倒了就算輸。
extra.hint_en: The assassins want the medic. If it falls, you fail.

extra.hint_zh: 幽靈、刺客、火罐都會找你的醫者。
extra.hint_en: Ghosts, assassins and pots all want your medic.

extra.hint_zh: 狂戰士一波衝上來。撐住，等他們自己累。
extra.hint_en: A berserker wave. Weather it.

extra.hint_zh: 幽靈會穿過前排去找沙漏精靈。
extra.hint_en: Ghosts drift through the front line for your sprite.

extra.hint_zh: 把最後面的投彈兵打倒，而且要打贏。
extra.hint_en: Defeat the bomber at the very back, and win.

extra.hint_zh: 長槍兵後面的鼓手讓大家都打得很快。
extra.hint_en: The drummer behind the pikes makes everyone faster.

extra.hint_zh: 熔岩旁邊很慢。對面的投彈兵最喜歡你站在那裡。
extra.hint_en: It's slow around the crater, right where their bombers want you.

extra.hint_zh: 樹擋得住人，擋不住幽靈。
extra.hint_en: Trees stop soldiers, not ghosts.

extra.hint_zh: 冰面會加速，衝鋒的人跑得更快。
extra.hint_en: The ice speeds you up, charges included.

extra.hint_zh: 兩道石牆把峽谷分成三條路。中間那條最慢。
extra.hint_en: Two rock walls split the canyon into three lanes; the middle one is slow.

extra.hint_zh: 上下兩條是快道。誰先繞到後面誰贏。
extra.hint_en: The outer lanes are fast. Whoever gets behind first wins.

extra.hint_zh: 對方守在橋口。兩座橋要一起攻。
extra.hint_en: They guard both bridgeheads. Hit both at once.

extra.hint_zh: 樹林把路切成幾段，泥地會讓人變慢。
extra.hint_en: Trees split the path; mud slows everyone.

extra.hint_zh: 熔岩塊把中間堵住，只能從上下繞。
extra.hint_en: The lava rock blocks the middle; go round.

extra.hint_zh: 河上只有兩座橋，敵人一定會從橋上過來。
extra.hint_en: Only two bridges cross the river. They must come over them.

extra.hint_zh: 上下兩條雪地會讓人變慢。讓敵人陷在裡面。
extra.hint_en: The snow bands slow everyone down. Keep them stuck there.

extra.hint_zh: 敵方的羊擠在他們自己的醫者旁邊。半路射死牠。
extra.hint_en: Their sheep stand by their own medics. Shoot them early.

extra.hint_zh: 對方有巫毒娃娃。別讓你最強的兵被綁住。
extra.hint_en: They have voodoo dolls. Don't let your heavy hitter get bound.

extra.hint_zh: 只能放兩隻。挑最能打的。
extra.hint_en: Only two. Pick the strongest.

extra.hint_zh: 對方的陣型和預算跟你一樣。擺法決定勝負。
extra.hint_en: Same troops, same gold. Placement decides it.

extra.hint_zh: 一樣的魔物、一樣的錢。
extra.hint_en: Same monsters, same gold.

extra.hint_zh: 只能放四隻魔物。
extra.hint_en: Four monsters, no more.

extra.hint_zh: 敵方的貓會把你的兵吸過去。讓它吸到寶箱怪。
extra.hint_en: Their cats pull your units in. Let them pull a mimic.

extra.hint_zh: 錢很多，但只能放四隻。
extra.hint_en: Plenty of gold, but only four units.

extra.hint_zh: 敵人比你多很多。三隻就要打贏。
extra.hint_en: They outnumber you. Win with three.

extra.hint_zh: 對方的盾兵會吸引你的近戰。讓遠程從旁邊打。
extra.hint_en: Their shields draw your melee in. Hit them from the side with range.

extra.hint_zh: 羊群衝過來前，一顆隕石可以先炸掉一大半。
extra.hint_en: One meteor can wipe out the flock before it arrives.

extra.hint_zh: 對方會丟隕石砸你最密的地方。在落下前開護盾。
extra.hint_en: They will drop a meteor on your densest spot. Shield before it lands.

extra.hint_zh: 可以治療兩次，冷卻很長。兩次都要用在刀口上。
extra.hint_en: Two heals with a long cooldown. Make both count.

extra.hint_zh: 戰吼讓大家打得更快，但只有一下子。挑兩邊撞在一起的時候。
extra.hint_en: War cry is short. Use it when the lines clash.

extra.hint_zh: 對方會先凍住你。等它解凍後，換你凍他們。
extra.hint_en: They freeze you first. Once it thaws, freeze them back.

extra.hint_zh: 治療只有一次。等大家都受傷了再放。
extra.hint_en: One heal. Wait until everyone is hurt.

extra.hint_zh: 對方會在衝上來時放戰吼。用護盾擋住那一波。
extra.hint_en: They roar as they hit you. Shield up for that wave.

extra.hint_zh: 騎兵衝過來的那一刻，讓他們停住。
extra.hint_en: Freeze the riders right as they charge in.

extra.hint_zh: 貓把敵人吸成一團之後，隕石一次砸好幾隻。
extra.hint_en: Once the cat bunches them up, one meteor hits many.

extra.hint_zh: 對方的護盾一過，就是你的戰吼。
extra.hint_en: When their shield fades, it's your war cry.

extra.hint_zh: 保護醫者，對手什麼都有。
extra.hint_en: Protect the medic against everything.

extra.hint_zh: 大軍壓境。撐住。
extra.hint_en: A huge army. Hold.

extra.hint_zh: 三條路、混搭敵軍。
extra.hint_en: Three lanes, a mixed foe.

extra.hint_zh: 魔物對魔物。
extra.hint_en: Monsters against monsters.

extra.hint_zh: 王國軍全部可用，對面也一樣。
extra.hint_en: All kingdom units, on both sides.

extra.hint_zh: 一顆隕石，一支貓隊。
extra.hint_en: One meteor and a cat squad.

extra.hint_zh: 最後面的骷髏法師就是頭目。
extra.hint_en: The skeleton mage at the back is the boss.

extra.hint_zh: 兩座橋，兩支軍隊，什麼兵都能用。
extra.hint_en: Two bridges, two armies, any unit.

extra.hint_zh: 只能帶五隻，對手有十隻。
extra.hint_en: Five units against ten.

extra.hint_zh: 最後一關。所有兵都能用，想清楚再放。
extra.hint_en: The last one. Every unit is yours. Think before you place.
